title: From Plant to Target: Uncovering a Novel Anti-Inflammatory Compound in Pouzolzia pentandra via Phytochemical, Cellular, and Computational Studies.
authors: Lam, Do Tien; Hung, Nguyen Anh; Hung, Dao Viet; Minh, Pham Thi Hong; Thuong, Hoang Thi Le; Le, Vu Thi Thu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物来源抗炎化合物的药理活性与靶点对接，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Phytochemical investigation of the ethyl acetate extract from the aerial parts of Pouzolzia pentandra led to the isolation and identification of fourteen compounds (1-14). These include known compounds such as beta-sitosterol (1), bauerenol (2), oleanolic acid (3), 3beta-friedelanol (4), kaempferol (5), quercetin (6), 2',6'-dihydroxy-3',4'-dimethoxychalcone (7), friedelan-3-one (8), dipterocarpol (9), 3beta-hydroxyolean-12-en-28-one 3-p-coumarate (10), daucosterol (11), astilbin (12), 3-methoxy-4-hydroxybenzoic acid (13), and pouzolignan F (14). Among these, compound 14 displayed the most potent inhibitory activity on nitric oxide (NO) production in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages, with an IC(50) value of 10.54 +/- 0.4 microM. Mechanistic studies further revealed that compound 14 significantly suppressed the LPS-induced release of key pro-inflammatory cytokines, tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) and interleukin-6 (IL-6). Furthermore, it inhibited the activation of the nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB) signaling pathway by preventing the nuclear translocation of its p65 subunit. Molecular docking studies were performed to evaluate the anti-inflammatory potential of compound 14 against cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) and phosphodiesterase-4 (PDE4). The compound exhibited binding affinities of -6.138 kcal/mol and -9.361 kcal/mol for COX-2 and PDE4, respectively. Subsequent molecular dynamics (MD) simulations confirmed the formation of a stable complex with the active site of PDE4. Collectively, these integrated in vitro and in silico findings demonstrate that pouzolignan F acts as a multi-target anti-inflammatory agent, likely through the inhibition of inflammatory mediators, cytokines, and the NF-kappaB pathway.
abstract_zh: 对Pouzolzia pentandra地上部分乙酸乙酯提取物的植物化学研究，分离并鉴定了十四个化合物（1-14）。这些包括已知化合物，如β-谷甾醇 (beta-sitosterol)（1）、bauerenol（2）、齐墩果酸 (oleanolic acid)（3）、3β-夫里德尔醇 (3beta-friedelanol)（4）、山柰酚 (kaempferol)（5）、槲皮素 (quercetin)（6）、2',6'-二羟基-3',4'-二甲氧基查尔酮 (2',6'-dihydroxy-3',4'-dimethoxychalcone)（7）、夫里德尔-3-酮 (friedelan-3-one)（8）、dipterocarpol（9）、3β-羟基齐墩果-12-烯-28-酮 3-对香豆酸酯 (3beta-hydroxyolean-12-en-28-one 3-p-coumarate)（10）、胡萝卜苷 (daucosterol)（11）、astilbin（12）、3-甲氧基-4-羟基苯甲酸 (3-methoxy-4-hydroxybenzoic acid)（13）和pouzolignan F（14）。其中，化合物14在LPS刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞中对一氧化氮 (nitric oxide, NO) 产生表现出最强的抑制活性，其IC(50)值为10.54 ± 0.4微摩尔。机制研究进一步揭示，化合物14显著抑制了LPS诱导的关键促炎细胞因子——肿瘤坏死因子-α (tumor necrosis factor-alpha, TNF-alpha) 和白细胞介素-6 (interleukin-6, IL-6) 的释放。此外，它通过阻止其p65亚基的核转位，抑制了核因子-κB (nuclear factor-kappa B, NF-kappaB) 信号通路的激活。进行了分子对接 (molecular docking) 研究，以评估化合物14对环氧合酶-2 (cyclooxygenase-2, COX-2) 和磷酸二酯酶-4 (phosphodiesterase-4, PDE4) 的抗炎潜力。该化合物对COX-2和PDE4分别表现出-6.138 kcal/mol和-9.361 kcal/mol的结合亲和力。随后的分子动力学 (molecular dynamics, MD) 模拟确认了与PDE4活性位点形成稳定复合物。综合这些体外和计算机模拟 (in silico) 研究结果表明，pouzolignan F作为一种多靶点抗炎剂，可能通过抑制炎症介质、细胞因子和NF-kappaB通路发挥作用。
